scenes.text: What if this Spring bean doesn't exist?
scenes.phonemes: wˌʌt ɪf ðɪs spɹˈɪŋ bˈiːn dˈʌzənt ɛɡzˈɪst?

scenes.text: A required audit publisher is missing. Spring cannot finish creating the service.
scenes.phonemes: ɐ ɹᵻkwˈaɪɚd ˈɔːdɪt pˈʌblɪʃɚɹ ɪz mˈɪsɪŋ. spɹˈɪŋ kænˈɑːt fˈɪnɪʃ kɹiːˈeɪɾɪŋ ðə sˈɜːvɪs.

scenes.text: Change the constructor parameter to Optional of AuditPublisher. Now absence is allowed.
scenes.phonemes: tʃˈeɪndʒ ðə kənstɹˈʌktɚ pɚɹˈæmɪɾɚ tʊ ˈɑːpʃənəl ʌv ˈɔːdɪt pˈʌblɪʃɚ. nˈaʊ ˈæbsəns ɪz ɐlˈaʊd.

scenes.text: With one matching publisher, Spring supplies an Optional containing that managed instance.
scenes.phonemes: wɪð wˈʌn mˈætʃɪŋ pˈʌblɪʃɚ, spɹˈɪŋ səplˈaɪz ɐn ˈɑːpʃənəl kəntˈeɪnɪŋ ðæt mˈænɪdʒd ˈɪnstəns.

scenes.text: With no publisher, Spring supplies an empty Optional. The service skips this extra notification.
scenes.phonemes: wɪð nˈoʊ pˈʌblɪʃɚ, spɹˈɪŋ səplˈaɪz ɐn ˈɛmpti ˈɑːpʃənəl. ðə sˈɜːvɪs skˈɪps ðɪs ˈɛkstɹə nˌoʊɾɪfɪkˈeɪʃən.

scenes.text: Both optional contexts start. Our tests confirm the values. Ambiguity can still fail. Keep critical security dependencies required.
scenes.phonemes: bˈoʊθ ˈɑːpʃənəl kˈɑːntɛksts stˈɑːɹt. ˌaʊɚ tˈɛsts kənfˈɜːm ðə vˈæljuːz. ˌæmbɪɡjˈuːɪɾi kæn stˈɪl fˈeɪl. kˈiːp kɹˈɪɾɪkəl sᵻkjˈʊɹɹᵻɾi dᵻpˈɛndənsiz ɹᵻkwˈaɪɚd.
